title: Pilot ask (AI chat)
description: A white band washed with pale pink on the right: a big semibold heading, three quoted founder questions and a short answer line, then a handwritten closing line with a pink brush stroke. Beside it a large rounded chat window with a soft pink ring bleeds to the frame edge, with a candy-pink callout pill (sparkle and a two-line claim) overlapping its bottom. Given chat frames, they crossfade in a loop.
notes: frames (up to three) crossfade on a 12s CSS loop; with none, the window is a plain placeholder
the wash and callout use the theme's glow colour
name: pilot-ask

props.name: title
props.description: the heading; \n sets the desktop line breaks

props.name: questions
props.description: the quoted questions, one per line

props.name: callout
props.description: the callout pill on the chat window

props.name: media
props.description: the chat window's content (a screenshot); a placeholder when empty

props.name: frames
props.description: chat screens that take turns in the window (up to three)
